note: Curated starting points, not an exhaustive list — any Ollama model can be pulled manually. minRamGB is a conservative floor for running the model at a usable speed; models are recommended on total system RAM because GPU VRAM cannot be read reliably across platforms (Windows WMI AdapterRAM under-reports modern cards).

models.name: nomic-embed-text
models.label: Embeddings (required)
models.description: Turns your documents into searchable vectors. Sidekick's Experts and memory cannot work without an embedding model — this one is small, fast and purpose-built.
models.why: Required. Everything retrieval-related depends on it.

models.name: llama3.2:3b
models.label: Small & fast
models.description: Quick, light model. Ideal for Sidekick's background work — summaries, fact extraction and research query generation — so your main model stays free for answering.
models.why: Best pick for the Background / Utility model slot.

models.name: llama3.1:8b
models.label: Balanced (recommended)
models.description: A solid general-purpose assistant. Good reasoning at a size most machines can run comfortably.
models.why: The best all-round starting point for conversation.

models.name: mistral:7b
models.label: Balanced alternative
models.description: Fast and capable, with a different style to Llama. Worth having as a second opinion in a Round Table.
models.why: Different model families disagree in useful ways on a panel.

models.name: qwen2.5:14b
models.label: More accurate
models.description: Noticeably stronger reasoning and instruction-following. Slower, but better for analysis, legal and medical work.
models.why: Choose this when accuracy matters more than speed.

models.name: qwen2.5:32b
models.label: High accuracy
models.description: Large model with strong reasoning. Best quality of the practical local options, at a real speed cost.
models.why: For deep analysis when you can spare the time and memory.

models.name: dolphin-mistral:7b
models.label: Uncensored
models.description: An uncensored fine-tune that will engage with topics a safety-tuned model may decline or hedge on.
models.why: Sidekick presents grounded facts and lets you decide; some users want a model that will not editorialise. Your choice of model is always yours (ROADMAP invariant #5).

models.name: gemma2:9b
models.label: Strong writer
models.description: Google's model, particularly good at clear prose. A useful voice for writing and editing Experts.
models.why: Pairs well with the Fiction Craft and Technical Writer Experts.
